This is untested prompt, not clip/wiring approval. No routine PhilQA request.

Flat pure #00FF00 green background. Rhukk is full body, centered, with exactly the proportions and colours of the supplied image: four clawed arms, two legs and one great curved horn. The horn grows from his face and stays attached to his head. The raised claw above his head is an arm's hand, not another horn; each arm has its own shoulder, elbow and clawed hand. He stays in the exact opening front three-quarter view: horn points to image-right, red eyes face the viewer, shell stays behind him. He never rotates, turns his back or turns toward or away from the camera. He makes one heavy melee claw swing toward image-right. His whole body sinks onto bent knees as his attacking upper arm draws back beside his shoulder, elbow bent. He drives through his legs, shifts his weight forward and leans his chest into the blow as that claw sweeps outward and down through a broad curved arc in front of him, not a straight jab. The other three arms bend and move naturally with his weight, balancing the swing; the raised arm is visibly jointed and moves separately from his head and horn. His shell and cloth follow his body's surge and recoil. His knees absorb the follow-through as his claw completes its arc, then his whole body flows back into the opening stance, all in one fluid motion with no pause. His feet remain in their original footprint and his figure stays centered at the same size, with all claws, horn and shell inside the generous green borders. No opponent, impact effect or projectile is drawn. The background is matte and casts no light on him. Locked-off static camera, no zoom, no pan. He settles into exactly his opening stance on the final frame.
